paleography.indonesian_translation: Semoga tiada rintangan dan berhasil. Obat sakit perut (wtĕŋ lara), sarana: pucuk daun dapdap, pucuk daun kacemcem, dipotong/disesep dibakar dalam abu (tambus), campurannya: ketumbar, irisan (bawang/kelapa?), disangrai, disemburkan. Obat sbahakbus pada kulit (sbahakbusriŋcaŕmma), sarana: segala macam pucuk daun, campurannya: bawang, kemiri, diiris-iris, semuanya disangrai, disemburkan. Sembur kepalanya, sarana: gahmangan, ..., diiris, beras, digiling halus, dimasak/dipanaskan, ... dibalurkan/ditempelkan. Obat tiwang labur, sarana: poh gedang (pepaya), terasi, diminum. Semburnya, sarana: pacang lepas, daun pahiduh, diiris dibakar dalam abu, babolong. Bedaknya, sarana: kulit kayu bohok, kulit kayu bintaro, cabai.
paleography.english_translation: May there be no obstacles and success. Medicine for stomach ache (wtĕŋ lara), ingredients: shoot of dapdap, shoot of kacemcem, chopped/sliced and roasted in ashes, adjuvants: coriander, sliced ingredients, roasted/toasted, applied as a spray/spit (sembur). Medicine for sbahakbus on the skin, ingredients: all kinds of shoots, adjuvants: onion, candlenut, sliced, all roasted, applied as a spray. Spray for the head, ingredients: gahmangan, ..., sliced, rice, ground finely, heated/cooked, applied as a plaster. Medicine for tiwang labur, ingredients: poh gedang (papaya), shrimp paste, drunk. The spray, ingredients: pacang lepas, daun pahiduh, sliced and roasted in ashes, babolong. The powder/body mask (wedak), ingredients: bark of bohok, bark of bintaro, chili.

paleography.indonesian_translation: Semoga tiada rintangan. Inilah tata cara pengobatan anak-anak, patut diketahui oleh yang menjalankan kewajiban dengan budi luhur. Adapun jika sang bayi lahir, jangan lengah mengamati tanda-tanda pada tubuh bayi, serta tangan dan kakinya, dan pandangan matanya. Jika bagian putih matanya membiru, tangan dan kakinya dingin, tangisnya serak, serta sayu mengantuk, dingin seperti itu, penyakitnya disebut blahan. Obatnya: sarana: sembung, beras merah, gamongan; tampalkan pada bagian celahnya (ubun-ubun/belahan). Dan untuk bedak/baluran tangan dan kakinya: sarana: buah sirih, nekuning, wangkongsari, jabug garum, pes gadu bang; balurkan, jangan sampai anak itu terlalu basah disiram. Dan untuk penutup dada/perutnya: sarana: umbi tuntung, bawang dadas. Dan jika bagian putih matanya membiru, uratnya tampak merah seperti darah, dan wajahnya pucat lemas serta sayu...
paleography.english_translation: May there be no obstacles. This is the procedure of medicine for children (usadha rare), to be understood by those serving with noble duty. When the child is born, do not be careless in examining the signs of the child, its hands and feet, and the center of its eyes. If the white of the eyes turns blue, its hands and feet are cold, its crying is hoarse, and it looks drowsy, cold in such a manner, its ailment is called blahan. The remedy: ingredients: sembung, red rice, gamongan; apply (as a poultice) to the cleft/fontanelle. Furthermore, for the powder/balm for its hands and feet: ingredients: betel nut/fruit, nekuning, wangkongsari, jabug garum, pes gadu bang; apply as a body powder, do not bathe/drench the child excessively. Furthermore, for its front/chest/belly: ingredients: umbi tuntung, crushed shallots. And if the white of the eyes turns blue, its veins appear bloody red, and its countenance is limp and drowsy...

paleography.indonesian_translation: Semoga tiada rintangan dan sukses. Inilah tata cara pengobatan anak-anak (usadha rare), hendaknya dipahami oleh para pengabdi ajaran Dharma. Jika anak baru lahir, jangan lengah mengamati tanda-tanda pada tubuh anak, tangan serta kakinya, dan pandangan matanya. Jika bagian putih matanya tampak kebiruan, tangan dan kakinya dingin, tangisannya serak/tertahan, serta sayu mengantuk, dingin seperti itu, penyakitnya disebut 'blahan'. Obatnya (hambanya), sarana: sembung, beras merah, gamongan, tempelkan pada belahannya (ubun-ubun/bagian yang sakit). Dan untuk bedak/balur tangan dan kakinya, sarana: buah sirih (buah base), nekuning, wangkongsari, jabug garum, pes gadu bang, balurkan, jangan tergesa-gesa memandikan anak tersebut. Dan untuk bagian dadanya (hadapnya), sarana: umbi tuntung, bawang dadas...
paleography.english_translation: Om, may there be no obstacles and success achieved. This is the procedure of child medicine (usadha rare), to be understood by the practitioners of Dharma. When the infant is born, do not be heedless in observing the signs on the child's body, the hands and feet, and the gaze of the eyes. If the whites of the eyes are bluish, hands and feet are cold, its crying is hoarse/suppressed, and looking drowsy, being cold like that, the illness is called 'blahan'. Its remedy, ingredients: sembung, red rice, gamongan, apply as a plaster/poultice onto the crack (fontanelle/affected area). And for the powder/rub for the hands and feet, ingredients: betel nut/fruit (buah base), nekuning, wangkongsari, jabug garum, pes gadu bang, rub it on, do not rush to bathe the infant. And for the chest/front, ingredients: umbi tuntung, bawang dadas...

paleography.indonesian_translation: Inilah ciri-ciri kucing, baik buruknya dari rupa serta perilakunya. Jika ada kucing sebulu (warna sama rata), belang di antara alisnya, segala macam tanda belang, memiliki pusaran bulu di ketiak kiri dan kanan, serta satu di dagu, itu pertanda baik. Khasiat/akibatnya: tidak akan didatangi oleh orang jahat, orang berniat jahat akan gagal karenanya; jika ada yang berbuat santet (desti) atau berniat mengganggu, akan musnah/netral karenanya, demikian keutamaannya. Kucing yang bulunya hitam, keempat kakinya bergaris/berbelang panjang, ekornya bundel (bergelung/berujung tumpul), pertanda baik (sulaksana), khasiatnya mendapatkan kemuliaan dan kebahagiaan serta tidak kekurangan harta. Kucing yang seluruh tubuhnya hitam, lambung kirinya memiliki bercak/totol putih, terlebih lagi bila ekornya bundel, itu dinamakan Wulan Karahinan, pertanda baik, apa pun yang dikehendaki akan terwujud. Kucing yang seluruh tubuhnya putih, lambung kanannya terdapat bercak hitam, terlebih lagi bila ekornya bundel, dinamakan Wulan Purnama, pertanda baik, khasiatnya mendapatkan kebahagiaan yang berkesinambungan. Kucing yang putih tubuhnya, hitam kepalanya, ekornya bundel, pertanda baik, dinamakan Bhujangga Hamengku, khasiatnya sangat besar keutamaannya.
paleography.english_translation: These are the characteristics of cats, the good and bad of their appearance and their behavior. If there is a cat of a single uniform color, with a streak between its brows, any form of streak/mark, having whorls on both the left and right armpits/flanks, and one on the chin, its sign is good. The effect: it will not be approached by malicious people, evil-intentioned people will be thwarted by it; if someone practices black magic (desti) or intends harm, it will be nullified by it, such is its excellence. A cat with black fur, all four legs striped/long-marked, and a bundled/coiled tail, is a good omen (sulaksana); the result is joy, power/nobility, and no lack of wealth. A cat whose entire body is black, with a white patch on its left flank, especially if its tail is bundled, is named Wulan Karahinan, a good omen, whatever is aimed for will be achieved. A cat whose entire body is white, with a black patch on its right flank, especially if its tail is bundled, is named Wulan Purnama, a good omen, the result is continuous happiness. A cat whose body is white, its head black, and its tail bundled, is a good omen, named Bhujangga Hamengku, the result is great excellence.

paleography.indonesian_translation: 1, Inilah ciri-ciri kucing, baik buruk rupa serta perilakunya. Jika ada kucing sebulu warnanya, cundang di sela alisnya, segala macam bentuk cundang, memiliki pusaran bulu pada ketiak kiri dan kanan, serta satu di dagu, itu buahnya (khasiatnya) tidak akan didatangi oleh orang jahat; orang berkeinginan jahat akan digagalkan olehnya; jika ada teluh, desti, atau yang mengganggu, akan dilebur/dinetralkan olehnya; demikian keutamaannya. Kucing berbulu hitam, keempat kakinya berbelang/panjal, ekornya bundel (bergelung/buntung), itu bertanda baik (sulaksana), buahnya membawa kemuliaan dan kekuasaan serta tidak kekurangan harta. Kucing seluruh tubuhnya hitam, lambung kirinya bertompok putih, lebih-lebih lagi bila ekornya bundel, itu bernama Wulan Karahinan, bertanda baik, segala yang diinginkan akan tercapai. Kucing seluruh tubuhnya putih, lambung kanannya bertompok hitam, lebih-lebih lagi bila ekornya bundel, itu bernama Wulan Purnama, bertanda baik, buahnya mendatangkan kebahagiaan yang berkesinambungan. Kucing putih badannya, hitam kepalanya, ekornya bundel, itu bertanda baik, bernama Bhujangga Hamengku, buahnya mendatangkan keutamaan yang besar.
paleography.english_translation: 1, These are the characteristics of cats, the good and bad of their appearance and their behavior. If there is a cat of uniform coat color, having markings between its eyebrows, all forms of cundang markings, hair whorls on both the left and right armpits, and one on the chin, its fruit/effect is that it will not be approached by evil people; wicked people with evil intents will be thwarted by it; if there are sorceries, black magic (deṣṭi), or disruptive spirits, they will be neutralized by it; such is its virtue. A cat with black fur, all four legs marked (panjal), with a curled/bobbed tail, is auspicious (sulakṣaṇa), its fruit brings fame, nobility, and abundance of wealth. A cat whose entire body is black, with a white patch on its left flank, especially if its tail is bobbed/curled, is named Wulan Karahinan, auspicious, whatever is desired will be achieved. A cat whose entire body is white, with a black patch on its right flank, especially if its tail is bobbed/curled, is named Wulan Purnama, auspicious, its fruit brings continuous happiness. A cat with a white body, black head, and a bobbed/curled tail is auspicious, named Bhujangga Hamengku, its fruit brings great excellence and virtue.

paleography.indonesian_translation: ...tiada yang mendadak berniat mencari kemasyhuran... //0// Semoga tiada rintangan //0// Sang pahlawan yang melakukan upacara kurban di medan perang berniat memusnahkan musuh-musuh, dengan tenang bagaikan bunga bertebaran rambut musuh di medan laga, gugurnya raja menjadi biji wijennya, perapian kurbannya adalah istana/kota musuh yang terbakar... demikianlah para perwira agung di pertempuran... bunga berhamburan harum baunya... gugur dalam pertempuran...
paleography.english_translation: ...none suddenly intends to seek fame... //0// May there be no obstacles //0// The valiant hero performing sacrifice on the battlefield desires the destruction of the enemies, casually like scattered flowers the hair of enemies on the battlefield, the falling of the slain king becomes the sesame seeds, his sacrificial firepit is the enemy's burning city/realm... such are the great warriors on the battlefield... scattered flowers fragrant... slain in battle...

paleography.indonesian_translation: ...tiada yang mendadak berniat mencari kemasyhuran... //0// Semoga tiada rintangan //0// Para pahlawan yang hendak melaksanakan kurban di medan perang berhasrat menumpas musuh, dengan leluasa laksana bunga yang bertaburan rambut para musuh di medan tempur, tumpukan para raja yang tewas menjadi biji persembahan, perapian korban adalah negeri musuh... tatkala para ksatria agung di medan laga gugur dalam pertempuran...
paleography.english_translation: ...there is none suddenly intending to gain renown... //0// May there be no obstacles //0// The heroes who perform the sacrifice on the battlefield desire to destroy the adversary, effortlessly like scattered flowers the hair of enemies in the arena of war, the fallen kings become the offering-grains, the sacrificial hearth is the enemy's land... when the great men fall in the combat on the battlefield...
